title: Wendell and the Autopsy
author: Theo Montrose
blurb: Ulyana Nystrom, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
